title: Response-free mathematical qualification of Free-Energy Moment-Onsager (FEMO)
scientific_question: Does the parameter-free physical free-energy S/M manifold admit unique interior profiles and a numerically positive-definite Onsager resistance operator with well-posed prescribed-head and prescribed-flux instantaneous boundary maps over the frozen B14 synthetic domains before any FEMO trajectory is generated?

family.local_profile: unique minimizer of integral F(theta) dz subject to S_i,M_i and frozen constitutive bounds
family.propagation: Onsager/minimum hydraulic dissipation projected onto the S/M tangent manifold

C6C.source: Use exactly both C6C partitions, seven C6C mean-Se profiles and six C6C moment patterns; boundary labels do not change the local state and are attached only for head-operator tests.

C6E.source: Use exactly the 42 D12 state targets and three response-independent HOLD flux anchors from C6E.

local_profile_numerical_contract.solver: scipy.optimize.least_squares on the two S/M residuals for A,B
local_profile_numerical_contract.invalid_trial_rule: If any quadrature suction leaves the frozen Se interval or is nonfinite, return a deterministic finite residual penalty; do not clip psi, theta or Se.
local_profile_numerical_contract.active_bound_policy: If an unconstrained affine-suction minimizer touches the frozen Se bounds within the margin, G4 fails and the obstacle-profile extension is not introduced in C6J.

tangent_metric_contract.tangent_definition: Use the exact local moment-map Jacobian J=int dtheta/dpsi [[1,x],[x,x^2]] dz and J^{-1} to compute partial theta/partial(S,M).

metric_grid.integration: composite trapezoidal per layer; interfaces are measure-zero and each layer is integrated separately

tangent_metric_contract.resistance: G_kl=int B_k(z) B_l(z)/K(theta(z)) dz, where B_k(z)=integral_0^z partial theta/partial y_k ds for scaled coordinate y.
tangent_metric_contract.total_storage_vector: C_k=d(total storage)/dy_k, equal to DeltaTheta*d_i for scaled S_i modes and zero for M_i modes.

prescribed_head.cases: Use the 168 C6C partition/profile/moment x HEAD_RISE/HEAD_FALL cases.
prescribed_head.bottom_potential: mu_b=-psi_bottom-H with psi_bottom equal to the C6C multiplier times suction at bottom-layer mean theta.
prescribed_head.gate: finite unique solve and scaled stationarity residual <=1e-10

prescribed_flux.cases: Use the 126 C6E D12 state x HOLD_Q_SE060/075/090 cases.
prescribed_flux.reduced_stationarity: Solve the equality-constrained quadratic Onsager KKT system [G C; C^T 0][y_dot,lambda]^T = [-(g_y-q0*b),0]^T.
prescribed_flux.gate: finite unique KKT solve, constraint residual <=1e-10 cm/day and scaled stationarity residual <=1e-10

boundary_operator_contract.reduced_energy_gradient: For layer affine suction psi=A+B*x, envelope theorem gives dE/dS=-A-zc and dE/dM=-B-1 under z-positive-down convention; transform by the frozen state scales.

qualification_gates.G1_FROZEN_STATE_MOMENT_REALIZABILITY: All C6C and C6E targets remain within the unchanged exact bounded moment domain.
qualification_gates.G2_LOCAL_PROFILE_CONVERGENCE: All five frozen A/B starts converge for every layer of every state case.
qualification_gates.G3_LOCAL_PROFILE_UNIQUENESS: All five starts agree within the frozen profile-parameter and theta tolerances.
qualification_gates.G4_INTERIOR_BOUNDED_PROFILE: Every qualified energy minimizer stays strictly inside the frozen Se interval by the preregistered margin; no obstacle extension is needed.
qualification_gates.G5_STATE_RECOVERY: Independent 192-point quadrature recovers every S and M target within the frozen gates.
qualification_gates.G6_LOCAL_MOMENT_JACOBIAN: Every local moment-map Jacobian is finite and negative definite.
qualification_gates.G7_ONSAGER_METRIC: Every scaled global resistance matrix is symmetric and positive definite and agrees with the independent 513-point construction.
qualification_gates.G8_PRESCRIBED_HEAD_OPERATOR: All 168 prescribed-head instantaneous FEMO rate solves satisfy the frozen stationarity gate.
qualification_gates.G9_PRESCRIBED_FLUX_OPERATOR: All 126 prescribed-flux KKT rate solves satisfy stationarity and exact total-storage-rate constraint gates.
qualification_gates.G10_NO_RESPONSE_DATA: No hydrological trajectory, C6D/C6E response metric or free-running reduced solution is read or generated.

decision_logic.FEMO_ONSAGER_OPERATOR_NOT_QUALIFIED: G1-G6 pass but any G7-G9 fails.
decision_logic.next_if_qualified: Authorize a separate prospective fresh-blind free-running FEMO preregistration only after defining immutable new histories/workload that have not been exposed to C5/C6 representation selection.
decision_logic.next_if_not_qualified: Stop FEMO without adding active-bound regularization, metric diagonal shifts, alternate state scaling, solver-start selection or response-driven terms.

stop_rules: No hydrological time trajectory in C6J.
No C6D/C6E response/error data may enter the FEMO equations, starts, gates or boundary levels.
No obstacle/bound-active extension if G4 fails.
No diagonal regularization of G or KKT systems.
No alternate metric or energy density after result.
No performance, speed, application or production-ROM claim.
